censored_or_negative_value.notes: The sample contains ND and less-than values but no negative values. ND is retained without inventing a numeric detection limit.

duplicate_sample_identifier.notes: Sample 1046-HM-S-618 has distinct atomic-absorption and optical-emission analysis rows. They remain separate records.

method_missing_or_multiple_candidates.notes: The duplicated sample has multiple explicitly reported methods; no method is guessed or selected as a replacement for the other.

claim_boundary: Thirty source observations were checked against the pinned SGB workbook rows and exact NUM_CAMPO joins to the official ArcGIS sample layer. This confirms traceability and parsing semantics, not national coverage, method comparability, or measurement truth.

codex_audit.notes: Raw source value, qualifier, record method and composite-key coordinate evidence agree with the fixture.
